tools.name: list_formats
tools.description: Lists the file formats Converter Studio converts and what each converts to. Give "from" (a format id such as "heic" or "mp4") to see the targets of one format. Needs no account.

tools.name: create_upload
tools.description: For a local file bigger than 8 MB: returns a one-time upload URL and a curl command. Run the command in a shell (files over 95 MB need parts, see partBytes), then call convert with the returned uploadId. The slot expires after an hour.

tools.name: convert
tools.description: Converts a file to another format and returns a download link (valid 6 hours). The file comes from "url" (a direct link or a Google Drive, Dropbox or OneDrive share link), "uploadId" (from create_upload) or "contentBase64" with "fileName" (files up to 8 MB). Uses credits from the user's converter.st

tools.name: get_conversion
tools.description: The status of a conversion by id, with its download link once done. Waits up to waitSeconds (at most 100) for it to finish.

tools.name: confirm_conversion
tools.description: Starts a conversion that waits for a go-ahead because it costs more than its maxCredits. Spends the shown credits: ask the user first. Waits up to 100 seconds for the result.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The user's converter.studio plan, credits left and file size limit.
